title: JobSpy API
description: Private, authenticated JSON job search API powered by JobSpy. Scraping depends on third-party job boards and may be rate-limited.
tagline: Search job boards through a private API
changelog: * Allow optional job description fetching via fetch_description
postInstallMessage: Open the app's Cloudron terminal and read `/app/data/api-key`. Keep this key private. Send `Authorization: Bearer <key>` with POST /scrape. Rotate the key by replacing that file with a new random key (at least 32 characters) and restarting the app. If the key is lost, delete the file and restart to generate a new one. Health: GET /health.
